tests.name: Untouched log verifies clean
tests.description: A freshly generated log is verified end-to-end. Every hash matches, every signature checks, and the sequence is contiguous.

tests.name: Replay a record
tests.description: Record 100 is replayed from the audit log. The stored inputs reproduce the same decision, confirming deterministic scoring.

tests.name: Edit a field
tests.description: A single field in record 100 is changed. The record's own hash no longer matches its content.

tests.name: Edit and recompute its hash
tests.description: Record 100 is edited and its hash recomputed. The hash now matches its (altered) content, but record 101's prev_hash no longer matches record 100's new hash, breaking the chain.

tests.name: Delete a record
tests.detail: 135 problem(s): record 100: sequence is 101 (gap, reorder or deletion)
tests.description: Record 100 is removed. Every subsequent record has a sequence number one higher than expected, producing 135 problems from record 100 onward.

tests.name: Reorder records
tests.detail: 6 problem(s): record 100: sequence is 101 (gap, reorder or deletion)
tests.description: A block of records is swapped. The sequence numbers no longer increase monotonically, and the hash chain is broken at every swap boundary.

tests.name: Truncate the tail
tests.detail: 1 problem(s): checkpoint 230: log ends at 220 (tail truncated)
tests.description: Records after position 220 are deleted. The last signed checkpoint at record 230 refers to records that no longer exist, revealing the truncation.

tests.name: Swap the model file
tests.detail: 230 problem(s): record 1: model file does not match logged model hash
tests.description: The model binary is replaced with a different file. Every record's logged model hash disagrees with the current model's hash, flagging all 230 records.

metadata.note: Recorded results from freshly generated logs with throwaway keys and a dummy model file. This is not a live check of the demo log.
